desc: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGaseousFor]{Gaseous Form} spell for 1 hour (no Concentration required) or until you end the effect as a Bonus Action.
This potion's container seems to hold fog that moves and pours like water.
name: potion of gaseous form
